title: An optimized protocol with a stepwise approach to identify specific nuclear receptor ligands from cultured mammalian cells
protocol: Dilute recombinant luciferase protein at 10 nM into LAS solution supplemented with 10 μM ATP.
Dilute luciferase inhibitor II stock solution in DMSO to obtain 100× concentrated solutions (1 mM, 100 and 10 μM).
Dilute tested compounds in DMSO to obtain 100× concentrated solution.
Prepare a 100 μM Luciferin solution in LAS solution supplemented with 10 μM ATP.
Protect the Luciferin solution from light until use.
In a white 96-well plate, add 90 μL of working solution.
Add 1 μL of DMSO or 1 μL of 100× luciferase inhibitor II solutions at final concentrations of 10 μM, 1 μM, and 0.1 μM for positive controls.
Add 1 μL of a 100× tested drug solution at final concentrations ranging from 10 μM to 100 nM.
Add 10 μL of the 100 μM Luciferin solution immediately before reading.
Shake the plate (preferably directly in the luminometer).
Collect light signal with a luminometer, acquiring data for 1 second.
Seed 10^6 HepG2 cells from passages 3 to 17 into 6-well plates using CG medium.
Incubate the seeded cells for 16 hours at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Mix 500 ng of expression vector (pSG5-GAL4(DBD)-hPXR(LBD), pGAL4-hCAR1, or pM) with 1 μg reporter vector (p(UAS)4-tk-Luc or p(UAS)4-tk-SEAP) and 100 ng of pRL in 100 μL sterile 150 mM NaCl.
Dilute 5 μL JetPEI transfection reagent in 100 μL 150 mM NaCl.
Combine the DNA mix with the JetPEI mix, vortex gently, and spin down briefly.
Incubate the combined mixture at 20 to 22°C for 20 minutes.
Replace medium by fresh CG medium and add the transfection mix to the cells.
Incubate transfected cells in CG medium overnight at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Seed transfected cells into white 96-well plates.
Wash cells with PBS warmed at 37°C.
Add 200 μL trypsin-EDTA solution and incubate for 10 minutes at 37°C.
Add 2 mL TCS medium to the cells.
Resuspend cells using a Combitips® and distribute 100 μL of cell suspension in each well (approximately 4.5 × 10^4 cells per well).
Incubate seeded cells for 16 hours at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Prepare 400 μL of CT medium for each condition.
Prepare 0.1% (v/v) DMSO as a negative control for CAR assay.
Prepare tested drugs with final DMSO concentration of 0.1% v/v.
Prepare 10 μM PK11195 as reference for blunted-basal activity in CAR agonist properties characterization.
Mix 10 μM PK11195 with 5 μM CITCO to serve as positive control.
Combine 10 μM PK11195 with tested drugs for assay.
Prepare 0.1% (v/v) DMSO as a negative control for PXR assay.
Mix 10 μM Rifampicin as positive control for PXR assay.
Prepare tested drugs with final DMSO concentration of 0.1% v/v for PXR assay.
Wash cells with PBS at 37°C.
Treat cells for 24 hours with 100 μL of prepared solutions.
Determine reporter activities using a luminometer plate reader.
Follow the instructions provided by the manufacturer to conduct Luciferase assays using Dual-Glo® Luciferase Assay System.
Seed 2.5 × 10^6 HepG2 cells in a 6 cm-diameter plate in CG medium.
Incubate the seeded cells for 16 hours at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere and 5% CO2.
Transfect cells with the peGFP-hCAR1 expression vector.
Dilute 5.5 μg of peGFP-hCAR1 expression vector in 250 μL sterile 150 mM NaCl.
Vortex gently and spin down the DNA mix briefly using a bench top centrifuge.
Dilute 11 μL JetPEI transfection reagent in 250 μL 150 mM sterile NaCl.
Vortex gently and spin down the JetPEI mix briefly using a bench top centrifuge.
Add JetPEI mix to DNA mix, vortex immediately and spin down briefly.
Incubate the transfection mix at 20°C–22°C for 20 min.
Replace medium with 5 mL fresh CG medium.
Add the transfection mix onto cells and incubate for 24 h at 37°C.
Pre-cool a 24-well plate, pipette tip box, and 10 mL cold (4°C) phenol red-free DMEM at −20°C overnight.
Thaw Matrigel aliquots on ice, mix gently, and dilute 2 mL in 4 mL cold phenol red-free DMEM.
Add 200 μL diluted Matrigel to each well of the pre-cooled plate.
Incubate the plate at 20°C–22°C for 1 h.
Wash cells with pre-warmed PBS (37°C).
Add 500 μL trypsin-EDTA solution and incubate for 10 min at 37°C.
Add 5 mL TCS medium, resuspend cells with a Combitips®, count cells, and dilute to reach 100,000 to 200,000 cells per mL.
Remove excess Matrigel from wells and wash carefully with pre-warmed PBS.
Add 1 mL cell suspension to each well of the Matrigel-coated plate.
Incubate the plate for 24 h at 37°C and 5% CO₂.
Prepare 2.5 mL of a 0.1% (v/v) DMSO solution as the negative control.
Prepare 2.5 mL of a 1 μM CITCO solution in 0.1% (v/v) DMSO as a positive control.
Prepare 2.5 mL of a 1 mM phenobarbital solution in 0.1% (v/v) DMSO as another positive control.
Prepare 2.5 mL of the tested drug solutions at the appropriate concentration with a final 0.1% (v/v) DMSO concentration.
Wash cells with PBS.
Add 1 mL of "cell treatment" solution to each well.
Incubate for 2 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Wash cells with PBS.
Fix cells for 15 min with 1 mL of a 4% paraformaldehyde solution (work under a fume hood).
Wash fixed cells twice with 1 mL of PBS.
Stain nuclei for 15 min with Hoechst-33258 at a concentration of 1:1000 in PBS.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Remove PBS and add one droplet of fluorescent mounting medium.
Cover the sample with a 12 mm diameter circular cover glass.
Visualize GFP and Hoechst signals using an epifluorescent microscope (excitation 485 nm / emission 530 nm for GFP, excitation 352 nm / emission 451 nm for Hoechst).
Take 2 to 3 pictures of 3 different fields for each well.
Seed transfected cells on plastic or Matrigel-coated wells.
Incubate seeded cells for 24 hours.
Treat cells with 0.1% DMSO, 1 μM CITCO, or 1 mM phenobarbital for 2 hours.
Stain nuclei with Hoechst-33258.
Observe and document the nuclear translocation of GFP-hCAR1 under a microscope.
Seed 10^6 HepG2 cells in a 6-well plate using CG medium.
Incubate the cells for 16 hours at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Co-transfect cells with expression vectors [pGal4-Rev-erbα or pM (Gal4 empty control vector) and pVP16-NCoR].
Add reporter vector(s) [p(UAS)4-tk-Luc and pRL (Luciferase)] to the transfection mix.
Prepare the transfection mix.
Dilute 500 ng of each expression vector in 100 μL sterile 150 mM NaCl.
Vortex gently and spin down the DNA mix briefly using a bench top centrifuge.
Dilute 5 μL JetPEI transfection reagent in 100 μL 150 mM NaCl.
Vortex gently and spin down the JetPEI mix briefly using a bench top centrifuge.
Add JetPEI mix to the DNA mix, vortex the solution immediately and spin down briefly.
Incubate the mixture at 20°C–22°C for 20 min.
Replace the medium with 2 mL fresh CG medium.
Add the transfection mix to the cells and incubate for 24 h at 37°C.
Seed transfected cells into a white 96-well plate on Day 3.
Wash cells with pre-warmed PBS (37°C) on Day 3.
Add 200 μL trypsin-EDTA solution to the cells and incubate for 10 min at 37°C.
Add 2 mL TCS medium to the cells.
Resuspend cells using a Combitips® and distribute 100 μL of cell suspension in each well (∼4.5×10⁴ cells per well).
Wash cells with pre-warmed PBS (37°C) on Day 4.
Prepare 0.1% (v/v) DMSO as a negative control on Day 4.
Prepare 10 μM GSK 4112 as a positive control on Day 4.
Prepare each tested drug alone with a final DMSO concentration of 0.1% v/v on Day 4.
Prepare each tested drug in combination with 10 μM GSK 4112 to evaluate potential antagonist properties on Day 4.
Treat cells for 24 h with 100 μL of prepared solutions on Day 4.
Use the Dual-Glo® Luciferase Assay System for Luciferase assay following manufacturer instructions.
Use the Great EscAPe™ SEAP Chemiluminescence Kit 2.0 for SEAP assay following manufacturer instructions.
Use the "in lab" protein quantification method for signal normalization.
